usage: jbus playbook [-h] [--name NAME] [--named]
                     {crewmate,scout,reviewer,home,expert} [brief]

positional arguments:
  {crewmate,scout,reviewer,home,expert}
                        who opens it
  brief                 the brief, request or plan whose Playbook: line names
                        it

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --name NAME           the playbook's name, in place of the line's
  --named               print the name the line gives, and open nothing
